module mg_00689(X, Y, reset, clk);
parameter depth=2, logDepth=1; 
  output Y; 
  input X; 
  input clk, reset; 
  reg [logDepth:0] count; 
  reg active; 
  assign Y = (count == depth) ? 1 : 0; 
  always @ (posedge clk) begin 
  if (reset == 1) begin 
  count <= 0; 
  active <= 0; 
  end 
  else if (X == 1) begin 
  active <= 1; 
  count <= 1; 
  end 
  else if (count == depth) begin 
  count <= 0; 
  active <= 0; 
  end 
  else if (active) 
  count <= count+1; 
  end
